description: Create a tool library checkout tracking spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/tool_checkout.xlsx. Add a header row with columns: Tool Name, Borrower Name, Checkout Date, Due Date, Days Out, Status, Late Fee. Add exactly 5 checkout records with realistic tool names and borrower names. Use TODAY() to calculate Days Out. Create formulas: Status should show 'OVERDUE' if days out > 7, otherwise 'OK'. Late Fee should calculate $2 per day beyond 7 days ($0 if not overdue). Include at least 2 overdue items and at least 2 OK items. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
